note: Grounded repaint v3 2026-10-21: one coherent ground-floor kitchen, single tiled floor, every figure on the floor, on a stool or at a real stove/table at true scale (no rows, no shelves, nothing floating). Feminine words left of the porthole swing doors, masculine words and adjectives right. One box per item. Exits: back door (outside), swing doors (dining hall), stairs up (upper kitchen); the windows are not exits.

items.scene: My AUNT (m'AHNT) in a straw sun hat tends her terracotta pot of fresh MINT on the windowsill by the sink.
A young cook presses the big red RESET button (ruh-SEHT) on the brick oven, a blank RECIPE card in her other hand, to start all over again.
Like English 'soup', said SOOP (rhymes with 'loop'): steam from a big copper pot of SOUP curls up into a giant LOOP-the-loop.
A cook at the stove smiles as she SAVOURS (sah-VUHR) the FLAVOUR on her wooden spoon.
A pony MARE sits on the floor hugging her TUM (ah-mehr-TEWM), face all puckered, after biting the lemon at her hooves: such BITTERNESS!
Like English 'preparation', but it starts with PRAY (pray-pah-rah-SYOHN): an apprentice boy PRAYS over his six little bowls of chopped vegetables, the PREPARATION done.
A FLEET (FREET) of little paper boats with paper sails is moored on the worktable, each loaded with golden FRIES.
Like English 'sauce', said SOHS (rhymes with 'dose'): a roast fish on its platter gets a huge DOSE of glossy brown SAUCE, with a little pot of extra beside it.
A little girl on a stool licks a spoonful of sticky purple GOO and smacks her lips: what a TASTE!
A boy waves 'SEE YA!' beside his DAILY calendar (day-lee-SYEUH) as he bites into a DELICIOUS cream tart.
A GREEN parrot on the grill rail cheers 'YAY!' (gree-YAY) over sausages GRILLED with black stripes.
A COOL cat in sunglasses sits NEAR the stove (kew-lee-NEHR) holding up a golden whisk, a CULINARY prize.
A COOK so QUEASY he has turned green all over sits stirring his pot, his bandaged KNEE (kwee-zee-NYAY) resting on a footstool.
A shaggy HAIRY COW (ah-ree-KOH) leans in at the window and munches a long green BEAN from a colander.
